items.message: Regeneration instructions reference an 'Archify skill' and a gh-pages branch copy step that are not documented anywhere else in the diff.
The 'expired' node's sublabel says 'sweep closes it' but the design prose in this same diff says sweep is not built.

The title says 'four lenses' but the lane label says 'Fan-out branches: one budget, one tape, one kill switch'; these are consistent, but the node 'Review(aspect) / four lenses' hard-codes four where the actual workflow reads lenses off the bound adapter dynamically.

The 'Trigger, resume' row in the table has a formatting accident: the GitLab CI cell contains text that was meant for a separate row ('a pipeline schedule on the default branch setting LOCKSTEP_IMPROVE=1; the measure and improve-propose jobs run the same two commands'), which was the old GitLab cell for the learning-loop row.
The line about diagrams is not wrapped to match the surrounding paragraph width, making it significantly longer than the 100-or-so-character convention visible in the rest of the file.
Fan-out branch keys are derived from the `ASPECTS` tuple and passed as `step=` identifiers without visible sanitization.
Sequential-to-fan_out rewrite has no accompanying test change in this diff.
New fan-out and ctx.park section has no test reference or gate entry.
